% Pattern: class/svjour. The journal option cmp of svjour numbers the
% environments of the class in one counter within the section.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass[cmp]{svjour}
\begin{document}
\section{Trees}
\begin{theorem} Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Each tree with two vertices or more has a leaf. \end{lemma}
\section{Forests}
\begin{theorem} Each forest with $k$ trees and $n$ vertices has $n-k$ edges. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
